title: creating a Page asks one question, its kind

criteria.text: Create asks one question, the kind, each a question with a one-line purpose; the screen says this just starts the process
criteria.note: `WhatAreYouStarting.tsx`: "What are you starting?", four answers, each with a line, and "This just gets things started" [V]. The fourth, "Be creative", is Don's own wording and not a question (#382, ruled 2026-10-05) Checked: unmarked: `WhatAreYouStarting.test.tsx` (questions, lines, nothing public); nothing asserts the "just gets things started" sentence. #575.

criteria.text: Creation lands the owner on the draft Page; name, address, neighbourhood, tags are set there
criteria.note: `startDraftAction` makes a draft of the kind and redirects to the Page [V]; Before-you-publish checklist and Edit on the draft (#326). Address/tags editing is F056 Checked: unmarked: `create/actions.test.ts` ("creates a draft ... and lands on it"); nothing asserts the draft offers name, address, tags. #575.

criteria.text: Map/card placement from a single read-time resolver; nothing precomputed or cached
criteria.note: `resolvePagePlacements` in `resolve-page-placement.ts` (T143), used by `resolveShop`; no placement column or cache found in migrations [V grep] Checked: no: `resolve-page-placement.test.ts` tests shape, not absence of stored placement. #576.
